packages.name: alloy
packages.descriptionShort: Grafana Alloy is an OpenTelemetry Collector distribution with programmable pipelines.

packages.name: logcli
packages.descriptionShort: LogCLI is the command-line interface to Loki.

packages.name: loki
packages.descriptionShort: Loki is a horizontally-scalable, highly-available, multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus.

packages.name: loki-canary
packages.descriptionShort: Loki Canary is a standalone app that audits the log-capturing performance of a Grafana Loki cluster.

packages.name: metaconvert
packages.descriptionShort: Grafana Metaconvert converts Cortex meta.json files to be on the Grafana Mimir format.

packages.name: mimir
packages.descriptionShort: Grafana Mimir provides horizontally scalable, highly available, multi-tenant, long-term storage for Prometheus.

packages.name: mimir-continuous-test
packages.descriptionShort: As a developer, you can use the standalone mimir-continuous-test tool to run smoke tests on live Grafana Mimir clusters. This tool identifies a class of bugs that could be difficult to spot during development.

packages.name: mimirtool
packages.descriptionShort: Mimirtool is a command-line tool that operators and tenants can use to execute a number of common tasks that involve Grafana Mimir or Grafana Cloud Metrics.

packages.name: promtail
packages.descriptionShort: Promtail is an agent which ships the contents of local logs to a private Grafana Loki instance or Grafana Cloud.

packages.name: query-tee
packages.descriptionShort: The query-tee is a standalone tool that you can use for testing purposes when comparing the query results and performances of two Grafana Mimir clusters. The two Mimir clusters compared by the query-tee must ingest the same series and samples.

packages.name: tempo
packages.descriptionShort: Grafana Tempo is an open source, easy-to-use, and high-scale distributed tracing backend.
